queries.sql: SELECT tf.id as tipo_falha_id, tf.nome as tipo_falha_nome, r.nome as rotina_nome, m.nome as modulo_nome, COUNT(*) as total FROM "atendimentos" "a" INNER JOIN "rotinas" "r" ON "r"."id" = "a"."rotina_id" JOIN "tipos_falha" "tf" ON "tf"."id" = "a"."tipo_falha_id" JOIN "modulos" "m" ON "m"."id" = "r"."modulo_id" GROUP BY "tf"."id", "tf"."nome", "r"."nome", "m"."nome" ORDER BY "tf"."nome" ASC, "total" DESC
